title: Brushless motor and propeller tests on an RC Benchmark 1520 thrust test stand
creator: PengCheng Cao and James Strawson
rights: Root MIT license covers software and associated documentation. A separate grant for measurements is not stated. Only original aggregates are distributed.
evidence: File-level comparison of 208 raw sweeps and their 208 publisher-edited versions. The README states that rebound samples were overwritten. Each row reports a command in microseconds and force, current and voltage on the bench. No torque signal is present.
fixed_file_url_rule: Append each file path, percent-encoded one segment at a time, to https://github.com/StrawsonDesign/motor_propeller_testing/blob/7031418317178b832b0be474a997f6da18f83a40/
scope: Bench-level inspection of command and independent physical measurements for R2. No flight deployment or controller optimization.
joined_input_boundary: These sources do not establish an upstream unclamped torque demand, its post-limiter command and an independently calibrated shaft torque on a common time base.
